scripts.desktop:package: npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --mac zip dmg --publish never
scripts.desktop:check: npm run desktop:build && node --check desktop-build/main.js && node --check desktop-build/preload.cjs && node --check desktop-build/renderer/renderer.js && node --check desktop-build/renderer/appearance.js
scripts.test:desktop: npm run desktop:build && playwright test desktop-ui pdf-preview sidebar
scripts.test:electron: npm run desktop:build && playwright test electron-stability --workers=1
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.desktop-main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.desktop-preload.json --noEmit
scripts.studio:check: npm run desktop:build && npm run runtime:prepare && node scripts/check-studio-package.mjs
